annotations.title: Start a large upload in parts

description: Start a large upload in parts. Needs any of `profile:write`, `content:write`, `inbox:write`, `bookings:write`. Two calls. The first changes nothing: it checks the arguments as the change would (a field this tool does not take is refused, by name) and answers a summary and a confirm_token. Show the summary to the person; only after they agree, call again with the same arguments plus confirm_token.

confirm_token.description: Leave out on the first call. On the second call, the confirm_token the first call answered.

name: start_multipart_upload
